name: Castle Pietrus
title: Castle Pietrus
summary: A large Viamontian castle at 19.4N 49.5W on a narrow ridge (z 140) above the western sea. It is a 200 m long grid of 26 m gold-roofed and spired towers and 13 m wall towers around a villa (a 16 m mansion with Captain Lasallia's quarters) and a red-roofed house, with red lion banners on the towers. The ridge falls 60-130 m to the sea on the west and 50-70 m to the east. The north end (y > 29376) lies in a landblock missing from the kit, so no camera goes there.

site.name: Castle Pietrus
site.notes: Derived @teleloc on the open saddle 36 m south of the south gate (ground 146.8, nothing within 35 m); the gazetteer's only Castle Pietrus entry is an interior cell (0x4198012E).

shots.standingOrder: Walk the saddle north toward Castle Pietrus's south gate between its two gold-spired towers, gliding 14 m closer 4 m above the grass with the lion banners above; stop 28 m short of the gate.
shots.notes: Steadicam approach. The camera walks the grassy saddle north toward the castle's south gate, between two 26 m gold-spired towers, gliding 14 m closer about 4 m above the grass with a gentle gait. The lion banners crown the towers. The late-morning sun lights the gate from the right. The nearest object is a spire tower at 26 m.
